runnerNotes: Pre-k6 measurement using a Deno script that drove gateway POST /load-test at three order counts and queried journal /metrics/latency for end-to-end pipeline percentiles. Captures the full submit→fill path, not just HTTP RTT.
findings: Pipeline latency is FLAT across 5x scaling (100→500 orders): p99 submittedToFilled holds at ~283-291ms regardless of concurrent order count.
The dominant cost is the 250ms market-sim tick interval. routedToChild p99 (~263-266ms) ≈ tick cadence — orders wait for the next tick to be evaluated.
Per-tick algo iteration is NOT the bottleneck at this scale. The predicate-index optimisation hypothesis from earlier architectural discussion was tested and falsified.
Journal ingestion (submittedToArrived) consistently sub-25ms p99, confirming the write batcher (50ms flush, 20-row batches) is well-sized.
EMS execution (childToFilled) actually IMPROVED with scale — p99 dropped from 34ms to 23ms across runs (likely warmup/JIT effects).
